title: Construction Class Advisor
creator: Twin City Fan
subject: Industrial and Commercial Fans
description: A p5.js recommendation activity in which learners choose the construction for six illustrative airstream inquiries (steam, steam at 220°F, a Type C specification on a non-ferrous radial bladed fan, a touchable 700°F kiln fan, flue gas recirculation and a stainless housing on a mild steel pedestal). Each recommendation is committed before the reason is shown; the first attempt is scored, one practice attempt is allowed, and a summary reports the score out of 6 with mastery at 5.
rights: Copyright 2026 Twin City Fan. All rights reserved.
source: FanPedia: The Fan & Blower Encyclopedia (Twin City Fan), https://tcf.com/fanpedia/, pp. 85, 107, 110, 116, 119, 122 and 145. Inquiries are illustrative.

educational.audience: New application engineers, sales staff, manufacturer's representatives, distributors and plant staff
educational.topic: Construction classes: moisture, high temperature, spark resistance, insulation, FGR and dissimilar metals
learningObjectives: Recommend the construction choice for six stated airstream inquiries, consistent with the FanPedia rules in Chapter 20, with at least 5 of 6 correct on the first attempt.
prerequisites: spark resistant Types A, B and C

accessibility.notes: describe() text for screen readers; keys A-D select an option and Enter commits it (or moves to the next inquiry once committed); option status is written as text labels ('your first answer: breaks a rule', 'correct recommendation') as well as shown by color.

controls.label: A / B / C / D
controls.purpose: Select one of the four construction recommendations (keys A-D)

controls.label: Recommend
controls.purpose: Commit the selected recommendation and show the verdict and reason (Enter)

controls.label: Next inquiry / See summary
controls.purpose: Move to the next inquiry once the first answer is committed; after inquiry 6, show the summary

controls.label: Start over
controls.purpose: Reset all six inquiries and the score

pedagogical.teachingStrategy: Committed recommendation with delayed reason, first-attempt scoring and one practice retry, followed by a summary review
pedagogical.interactionPattern: Choose one of four options per scenario; commit before feedback
keyQuestions: Which airstream condition in the tags decides the construction, and which tags are distractors?
Which chapter rule does each rejected option break?
Why does a Type C specification end in a Type B recommendation when the impeller is already non-ferrous?
commonMisconceptions: High moisture and high temperature construction can be stacked.
Type C is always the lowest-cost answer, even when the impeller is already non-ferrous.
Insulation is only for heat (it also addresses condensation, sound and personnel protection).
A stainless housing can always be welded to a mild steel pedestal.
An FGR job is just a normal inlet box.
assessmentOpportunities: First-attempt score shown as 'n of 6'; mastery is 5 or more, reported as 'You can turn an airstream into a construction line.'
Summary list of each inquiry's first answer, correct answer and reason, for the learner to name the rule each wrong answer breaks.
